Subtract 40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 3 days → total subtract 283 days.  
1436-08-18 minus 283 days:  
1436 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
Days before Aug 18 in 1436: Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 = 213 days.  
18 days in August → 231 days elapsed.  
283 − 231 = 52 days into previous year (1435).  
1435 is not leap (1435 ÷ 4 = 358.75).  
Dec 31 of 1435 is day 365.  
365 − 52 = 313 days into 1435.  
Months: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30.  
Sum to Oct 31: 304 days. 313 − 304 = 9 days into November.  
→ 1435-11-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1435-11-09
